evidence.rule: evaluates hypothetical consequences of candidates and chooses by them
evidence.what: look-ahead: candidates are scored by the predicted outcome `obs - a` and chosen by .index
evidence.influence: prediction to scores: op-@6 -> call:abs@6 -> op+=@6 -> score@6 -> scores.weak@7  [data]; chosen value to action: call:method:index@8 -> <return>@8 -> return:2.get_action  [data]
assumptions: `obs - a` is read as the state after applying a candidate (additive transition)
the chosen candidate becomes the action through a state-independent encoding
